originalTitle: Apple is ‘not able to predict’ when it’ll have enough iPhone Duos to go around
summary: Apple CEO John Ternus doesn't have a timeline for when iPhone Duo supply constraints could lift. content: Apple CEO John Ternus doesn’t have a timeline for when iPhone Duo supply constraints could lift. During an interview with Reuters, Ternus said the company is “working hard to get it to as many customers as quickly as possible, but at this ​point, we’re not able to predict when supply and demand will be in balance.” Apple launched its first foldable last month for $1,999, featuring a 5.4 outer display and 7.6-inch inner screen. Preorders for the iPhone Duo quickly sold out, with some shipments expected to arrive in 2027. Apple also made a limited number of iPhone Duo models available in-store at launch. In his interview with Reuters, Ternus also addressed reports about cracked screens, saying “a very small percentage” of iPhone Duos were returned for this issue, and that Apple is replacing them. The company has contended with supply chain constraints and rising memory costs for months now. This resulted in price increases across its product lineup, along with higher iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max starting prices. “What we’re seeing with memory pricing right now is unprecedented,” Ternus said during Apple’s Q4 2026 earnings call on Monday. Ternus added that the company expects to see “even higher memory costs” during Apple’s December quarter but notes that this is “partly offset” by recent price increases. Even without a standard iPhone 18 model, Apple reported record-breaking iPhone revenue at $57.58 billion during its fourth quarter.
chineseTitle: 苹果“无法预测”何时会有足够的 iPhone Duo 可供使用
chineseSummary: 苹果首席执行官 John Ternus 没有给出 iPhone Duo 供应限制何时解除的时间表。在接受路透社采访时，Ternus 表示，该公司“正在努力尽快将其提供给尽可能多的客户，但目前，我们无法预测供应和需求何时会达到[...]
chineseContent: 苹果首席执行官 John Ternus 没有给出 iPhone Duo 供应限制何时解除的时间表。在接受路透社采访时，Ternus 表示，该公司“正在努力尽快将其提供给尽可能多的客户，但目前，我们无法预测供需何时会达到平衡。”苹果上个月推出了首款可折叠手机，售价 1,999 美元，配备 5.4 英寸外屏和 7.6 英寸内屏。 iPhone Duo 的预订很快就被抢购一空，部分发货预计将于 2027 年到达。苹果还在发布会上在店内提供了数量有限的 iPhone Duo 型号。在接受路透社采访时，Ternus 还谈到了有关屏幕破裂的报道，称“极小部分”iPhone Duo 因该问题被退回，苹果正在更换它们。几个月来，该公司一直在应对供应链限制和内存成本上涨的问题。这导致其产品线价格上涨，以及 iPhone 18 Pro 和 Pro Max 起价上涨。 Ternus 在苹果 2026 年第四季度财报电话会议上表示：“我们目前看到的内存定价是前所未有的。” Ternus 补充说，该公司预计苹果公司 12 月季度的内存成本将“更高”，但指出这将被最近的价格上涨“部分抵消”。即使没有标准的 iPhone 18 机型，苹果第四季度的 iPhone 收入也创下了 575.8 亿美元的创纪录纪录。
